_comment: Per-tag ground truth for libpng CVEs used in design-science validation. Each entry pins the vulnerable file/function at the documented site. line_range is optional and may be omitted when the function name alone is enough to scope the check. Sources: NVD (nvd.nist.gov), MITRE CVE, and libpng commit history.

v1.2.54.summary: Out-of-bounds read in png_check_keyword via crafted text-chunk keyword. Still present at 1.2.54 (fixed in 1.2.55).

v1.6.34.summary: Integer overflow in png_check_chunk_length leads to incorrect buffer size in palette/chunk handling.

v1.2.53.summary: Heap-based buffer overflow in png_handle_PLTE when reading PNG with crafted palette length.
Out-of-bounds read in png_check_keyword via crafted text-chunk keyword.
